requirements.text: The web application should provide a textarea element with the attribute data-testid='text-input' where users can input text freely without immediate restrictions. Upon entering text, the system should update the word count, character count, and paragraph count displayed in elements with data-testid='word-count', 'char-count', and 'para-count', respectively. The user can input text of any length, including large texts up to 5000 characters, without restrictions. The system should persist the entered text and counts in localStorage using keys 'text', 'words', 'chars', and 'paras'. Additionally, the application should allow users to set a character limit via an input element with data-testid='char-limit', and visually indicate when the character count exceeds this limit by changing the text color to red in the 'char-count' element. The system should also provide functionality to clear the text and counts via a button with data-testid='clear-button', and highlight specific words in the text using a button with id='highlight-button' and an input with id='highlight-word'.

The web application should provide a text input area identified by the attribute data-testid='text-input' where users can enter text. Upon clicking the 'Count' button, identified by data-testid='count-button', the system must calculate and display the number of words, characters, and paragraphs in the text input. The results should be shown in elements with data-testid='word-count', 'char-count', and 'para-count', respectively. The word count should exclude empty strings resulting from spaces or newlines. The character count should include all characters, including spaces and special characters. The paragraph count should consider non-empty lines separated by newlines. The system should handle edge cases such as empty input, input with only spaces or newlines, and input with special characters. Additionally, the application should persist the text input and counts in localStorage using keys 'text', 'words', 'chars', and 'paras', and reload them upon page refresh. If a character limit is set in the input field with data-testid='char-limit', the character count should change color to red if the limit is exceeded, and the text should indicate the excess.

The web application must provide a 'Clear' button, identifiable by the data-testid 'clear-button', which, when clicked by the user, clears the text input field with data-testid 'text-input' and resets the word count (data-testid 'word-count'), character count (data-testid 'char-count'), and paragraph count (data-testid 'para-count') to zero. This functionality should work regardless of the current state of the text input, including when it is already empty. Upon clearing, the text input field should be empty, and the counts should display 'Words: 0', 'Characters: 0', and 'Paragraphs: 0'. The system should ensure that these changes are reflected in the UI immediately after the button is clicked.

generated_cases.title: Normal Text Input and Count Calculation
generated_cases.description: Verify that entering standard multi-word and multi-paragraph text in the text input area correctly updates the word count, character count, and paragraph count upon clicking the count button or typing.

generated_cases.title: Empty Text Input Handling
generated_cases.description: Verify that providing an empty string in the text input area correctly displays zero for word count, character count, and paragraph count.

generated_cases.title: Whitespace and Newline Only Input Handling
generated_cases.description: Verify that input containing only spaces or newlines correctly handles empty string exclusions for word and paragraph counts while accurately reflecting the character count.

generated_cases.title: Large Text Input Handling up to Limit
generated_cases.description: Verify that entering a large text up to 5000 characters functions correctly without restriction and updates all corresponding counts.

generated_cases.title: Character Limit Exceeded Indicator
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting a character limit and entering text that exceeds this limit visually indicates the excess by turning the character count text color to red.

generated_cases.title: Character Limit Not Exceeded Indicator
generated_cases.description: Verify that setting a character limit and entering text within or equal to this limit does not trigger the red text color on the character count element.

generated_cases.title: LocalStorage Persistence and Reload
generated_cases.description: Verify that entering text and counts correctly saves them into localStorage using keys 'text', 'words', 'chars', and 'paras', and that they reload upon page refresh.

generated_cases.title: Clear Button Functionality with Active Text
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the clear button when the text input contains data successfully clears the text input field and resets all counts to zero in the UI.

generated_cases.title: Clear Button Functionality when Already Empty
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the clear button when the text input field is already empty maintains zero counts and successfully executes without error.

generated_cases.title: Special Characters Input Handling
generated_cases.description: Verify that input containing special characters is properly accounted for in the character count and handled correctly in counts.

generated_cases.title: Character limit exactly at boundary value
generated_cases.description: Set the character limit input to 5000 via data-testid='char-limit' and enter exactly 5000 characters in data-testid='text-input'. Verify that the character count does not indicate excess and is not red.

generated_cases.title: Character limit immediately within upper boundary
generated_cases.description: Set the character limit input to 5000 via data-testid='char-limit' and enter 4999 characters in data-testid='text-input'. Verify that the character count does not indicate excess.

generated_cases.title: Character limit outside upper boundary
generated_cases.description: Set the character limit input to 5000 via data-testid='char-limit' and enter 5001 characters in data-testid='text-input'. Verify that the character count visually indicates excess by changing text color to red in data-testid='char-count'.

generated_cases.title: Lower boundary character limit (zero characters)
generated_cases.description: Set the character limit input to 0 and enter 0 characters in data-testid='text-input'. Verify counts and limits behavior.

generated_cases.title: Lower boundary character limit exceeded by one
generated_cases.description: Set the character limit input to 0 and enter 1 character in data-testid='text-input'. Verify that the character count changes to red indicating excess.

generated_cases.title: Transition from Empty State to Text Entered State
generated_cases.description: Verify that entering text in the textarea (data-testid='text-input') updates the counts and persists them in localStorage.

generated_cases.title: Transition from Text Entered State to Cleared State via Clear Button
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the clear button (data-testid='clear-button') resets the textarea and all count displays to zero from any state.

generated_cases.title: Transition to Character Limit Exceeded State
generated_cases.description: Verify that exceeding the set character limit in data-testid='char-limit' triggers a visual warning by turning the character count text color red.

generated_cases.title: Forbidden Transition: Invalid Clear Action on Unmounted Element
generated_cases.description: Ensure the system forbids triggering clear actions when the clear button is missing or disabled.

generated_cases.title: End-to-End Text Input, Real-time Counting, Persistence, and Highlighting
generated_cases.description: User enters text freely in the textarea (data-testid='text-input'), verifies real-time updates for word, character, and paragraph counts, tests character limit enforcement with red color indication in 'char-count', persists data in localStorage, and uses the highlight feature.

generated_cases.title: Manual Count Calculation, Edge Cases Handling, and State Reloading
generated_cases.description: User enters text into 'text-input', clicks the 'Count' button (data-testid='count-button'), verifies correct calculations excluding empty strings and including special characters, checks state reloading from localStorage after refresh, and tests character limit exceedance indicator.

generated_cases.title: Clear Input and Reset Counts Workflow
generated_cases.description: User inputs text and generates counts, then clicks the 'Clear' button (data-testid='clear-button') to ensure the text input and all counts ('word-count', 'char-count', 'para-count') are reset to zero immediately in the UI.

generated_cases.title: Character limit exceeded error handling
generated_cases.description: Enter text exceeding the limit set in data-testid='char-limit' and verify that the 'char-count' element changes its text color to red and indicates the excess.

generated_cases.title: Empty input and whitespace-only handling
generated_cases.description: Input only spaces or newlines into data-testid='text-input' and verify that the word count, character count, and paragraph count handle these edge cases correctly without failing.

generated_cases.title: Clear button redundancy check
generated_cases.description: Click the button with data-testid='clear-button' when the text input field is already empty and verify that the counts remain at zero and UI updates properly.

generated_cases.title: Large text input persistence
generated_cases.description: Input a large text close to 5000 characters into data-testid='text-input' and refresh the page to verify correct localStorage persistence and reloading for keys 'text', 'words', 'chars', and 'paras'.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User enters text into the textarea
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Text Input Functionality
  The system should allow the user to input any text into the textarea without immediate restrictions.


Scenario: [Normal] User enters text into the textarea
    Given the Word Counter page is loaded
    And the textarea with data-testid "text-input" is empty
    When the user enters "Hello World" into the textarea with data-testid "text-input"
    Then the textarea with data-testid "text-input" should contain the text "Hello World"

reference_cases.title: [Edge] User enters a large amount of text into the textarea
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Text Input Functionality

    Then the textarea with data-testid "text-input" should contain the text of 5000 characters

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Count words, characters, and paragraphs for a typical input
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Word, Character, and Paragraph Counting
  The system should calculate and display the number of words, characters, and paragraphs in the text input when the user clicks the 'Count' button.


  Scenario: [Normal] Count words, characters, and paragraphs for a typical input
    Given the webpage is loaded
    And the user enters "Hello world! This is a test.\nThis is a new paragraph." into the text area with data-testid "text-input"
    When the user clicks the 'Count' button with data-testid "count-button"
    Then the word count displayed with data-testid "word-count" should be "Words: 11"
    And the character count displayed with data-testid "char-count" should be "Characters: 53"
    And the paragraph count displayed with data-testid "para-count" should be "Paragraphs: 2"

    And the character count displayed with data-testid "char-count" should be "Characters: 0"
    And the paragraph count displayed with data-testid "para-count" should be "Paragraphs: 0"

reference_cases.title: [Error] Count words, characters, and paragraphs for input with special characters
reference_cases.description:

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Clear text input and reset counts
reference_cases.description:

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Cover important input partitions such as empty input, input with only spaces/newlines, normal text, and special characters for word, character, and paragraph calculations.
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Exercise stated limits such as large texts up to 5000 characters and the custom character limit set via the char-limit input.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Cover relevant states like entering text, clicking count/clear buttons, exceeding character limits, and persisting or reloading state via localStorage.
technique_rationales.use_case: Cover the end-to-end user workflows involving typing text, calculating counts, setting limits, highlighting words, clearing fields, and page refresh persistence.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Explore plausible failure conditions such as clearing an already empty input field and handling edge cases with whitespace and newlines.
